CULTURAL ASPECTS OF DIETARY PLANNING
To plan diets for individuals or groups that are appropriate 
from a health and nutrition perspective, registered dietitian 
nutritionists and health providers must use resources that are 
targeted to the specific client or group. Numerous population 
subgroups in the United States and throughout the world have 
specific cultural, ethnic, or religious beliefs and practices to 
consider. These groups have their own set of dietary practices,
